simple.meaning: מִשְׂרָפָה (misrâphâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “combustion , i.e. cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׂרָפָה (H4955) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 33:12, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׂרָפָה (H4955) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׂרָפָה (misrâphâh) / H4955 is traced through Isaiah 33:12, Jeremiah 34:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: The peoples will be like the burning of lime,

You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says Yahweh.”
